items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Okay well Ella and Louis Armstrong had made records together, so they, they – on that Monday night, I had to battle both of them, with my band.

ctx.x: I recorded Groovin High, and I had stuff in there that no other band was playing because I had already got into harmony that was quite deep. And when you hear my Groovin High, you’ll understand why I am saying that. And uh, Snooky stayed with me, we went on, and then we went back to this club in St. Louis. This time, it’s Ella Fitzgerald, and we were together. We’re together there in this big club. So we’re playing there, and every Monday night they have what they call a battle of the bands, on Monday night. Okay…
What inspired you to have to go back and study?
